decision.reason: [ev-77837469197a] gives the subject (the `-legacy-read-mode` flag) and the change: the flag is deprecated and its default is flipped to `false`, so the earlier default was presumably `true`. It does not say what legacy read mode does, which component or deployment mode uses it, or what behaviour changes when the default moves to `false`. That leaves applicability (who relies on the default) and consequence (what happens to an operator who does nothing) undecided. The one-line changelog entry only points to PR 11665 for details, so we need the PR or the upgrade-guide text.
